notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green plus the number of times you've cast your commander from the command zone this game is equal to or greater than seven.
description:
Cast Karametra's Acolyte for its blitz cost by paying at most {3}{G}, causing it to enter the battlefield with haste.
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to your devotion to green.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
